semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokyo Tan-ichi provides specialized equipment and components crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Tokyo Tan-ichi specializes in high-precision press parts and automated equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. They focus on in-house production of press and molding dies, ensuring high precision and quality, and offer prototype support for various production scales. Their facilities are certified under ISO9001/14001 and IATF16949, highlighting their commitment to quality and reliability.
capabilities: Automated equipment tailored to customer specifications
Prototype support with simple progressive dies
